pr_title: feat: welcome pop-up "Comenzar" stays in the sandbox (#40)
copilot_review_summary: Copilot review: skipped by config/flag (no .vt/vt.config.yaml in this repo, so review.copilot_integration is not enabled). Visual E2E: no ui-visual-reviewer agent; covered by the Playwright browser check (65/65 at 320×568, 390×844, 1280×800, 844×390; validaciones/shell_generator/40). Verification pass: not run (no C/S findings). Security reviewer: no C/S findings (static interpolated label, no new input/URL/binding, navigateToGame() keeps its fixed route). Reviewers: 3 role-scoped `reviewer` instances (security, quality, documentation). Reviewed head: 59e78f3.

findings.title: The focus spec only says "not Comenzar"; it can pass vacuously
findings.description: `expect(document.activeElement).not.toBe(start())` also passes if focus is on `body` or on another wrong element (e.g. an `initialFocus` pointed at "Conoce más"). `modal.component.spec.ts:206` shows showModal does move focus to the ✕ in Karma.

A.approach: Assert the positive outcome: `activeElement` is the header ✕ (keep the not-Comenzar assertion).
A.rationale: Pins the owner decision "focus stays on the ✕" and fails on any other element.

C.approach: Rename the spec to say it only excludes Comenzar.

findings.title: "Comenzar doesn't open the ? guide" isn't pinned
findings.description: The closes-and-stays spec checks the pop-up, the router and the sliders, but not `component.guide.on`. A future handler that also opened the guide (a discussed alternative) would pass.

findings.title: No assertion on the router URL after Comenzar
findings.description: Only `navigate`/`navigateByUrl` are spied; the component has one navigation path, so coverage is already good.

B.rationale: The spies cover the only navigation path.

findings.title: #3 archive: inline markers promised by FR-008 are missing on many "Jugar" lines
findings.description: plan.md has one blockquote (mid-list) and no inline markers; its Mermaid `play[... navigateToGame()]` and handler steps read as current. spec.md marks US3, FR-007, D4, VM-009/010, SC-004 but not FR-008, its Mermaid node, the US2/VM-016 close lists or line ~295.

A.approach: Add short inline markers on the unmarked lines in both files; move plan.md's note to the top.
A.rationale: Delivers what FR-008 and the PR promise.

B.approach: Keep the note-only approach and reword FR-008/plan/PR.
B.rationale: Smaller archive diff, more spec churn.

C.approach: Mark only the Mermaid nodes and VM-016; move the plan note.

findings.title: #3 VM-009/VM-010/SC-004 cite spec names that #40 renamed, still "Pass"
findings.description: The evidence names "Conoce más and Jugar › \"Jugar\" closes the pop-up and opens the game" and "…\"Jugar\" on screen…"; those specs are now "Conoce más and Comenzar" / "closes and stays".

A.approach: Extend the marker: the evidence describes the #3-era behaviour; renamed in #40, see #40's VM-002/VM-004.

findings.title: #40 SC-002/FR-003 say no "Jugar" remains, but history comments mention it
findings.description: `sandbox.component.ts` (`was #3's "Jugar"`) and two spec lines mention Jugar on purpose.

A.approach: Reword: no "Jugar" button, id, label constant or handler remains; history comments may mention it (archive + issue spec comment).

findings.description: "Focus is the ✕" was only evidenced by the browser check.

A.approach: Resolved by m1 (unit spec asserts the ✕); cite both at stamping.
